title: Illustrating the Lost Continent
content: Here's a little teaser video I produced to show you how I make my dinosaur paintings.(Link to video) A few weeks ago,Scientific Americanmagazine asked me to paint two dinosaur scenes for an article called "Dinosaurs of the Lost Continent," about the amazing recent discoveries of paleontologist Scott Samson in southern Utah. The illustrations will appear in the next (March) issue of Scientific American.I'll tell you more about the making of those paintings in future blog posts, but I want to let you know that I'm currently working on an hour-long video (DVD and download) to show the process in great detail.---------Many thanks to art director Michael Mrak, paleontologistScott Sampson, and composerKevin Macleod.Blog post about the video on Scientific American websitePreview of the article in S.A.: "Dinosaurs of the Lost Continent"Previously on GurneyJourney:Mud Trap (behind the scenes on another Scientific American illustration)Video in the Works (78 comments)
